limits: Exact source-byte hashes and exact grammar quote offsets do not constitute a full independent comparison with the original web page or a pedagogic quality review.

Repeated reading/listening uses of the same normalized word sequence form one input family and contribute lexical coverage once.

Grammar tags need exact source quotes; quote presence alone does not validate the teaching explanation or progression.
These supplemental source counts do not set a daily new-word quota, schedule future requirements, prove exposure/mastery, or alter any historical record.
